latest_release.name: v10.4.0
latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
* Add warning on incompatible formatters.level with multi-target transports by @lraveri in https://github.com/pinojs/pino/pull/2381
* chore: use TSTyche for type testing by @mrazauskas in https://github.com/pinojs/pino/pull/2376
* Add Sentry Native Integration Docs by @KyleTryon in https://github.com/pinojs/pino/pull/2394
* docs: add flush limitation warning for pino-pretty, fix #1015 by @mcollina in https://github.com/pinojs/pino/pull/2402
* feat(browser): add redaction support by @abhu85 in https://github.com/pinojs/pino/pull/2396
* chore: lint the type declaration file by @mrazauskas in https://github.com/pinojs/pino/pull/2408
* chore: remove TSTyche config file by @mrazauskas in https://github.com/pinojs/pino/pull/2409
* docs: clarify multi-target formatter limitation by @mcollina in https://github.com/pinojs/pino/pull/2410
* No bots allowed by @mcollina in https://github.com/pinojs/pino/pull/2412
* build(deps): bump real-require from 0.2.0 to 1.0.0 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/pinojs/pino/pull/2414
* build(deps-dev): bump neostandard from 0.12.2 to 0.13.0 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/pinojs/pino/pull/2418
* fix: use util.getCallSites when able to allow frozen intrinsics by @CarlOlson in https://github.com/pinojs/pino/pull/2294
* Update AWS Lambda reference in asynchronous docs by @urbanautomaton in https://github.com/pinojs/pino/pull/2413
* chore: update license by @Tony133 in https://github.com/pinojs/pino/pull/2375
* fix: add named `default` export by @mrazauskas in https://github.com/pinojs/pino/pull/2421
* Update contrib doc by @jsumners in https://github.com/pinojs/pino/pull/2424
* docs: use @hono/structured-logger for Pino with Hono by @brunorodmoreira in https://github.com/pinojs/pino/pull/2425
* chore(deps): remove `pre-commit` by @kshitijanurag in https://github.com/pinojs/pino/pull/2423
* build(deps): bump actions/github-script from 8 to 9 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/pinojs/pino/pull/2427
* build(deps-dev): bump eslint-plugin-promise from 6.6.0 to 7.3.0 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/pinojs/pino/pull/2428
* build(deps-dev): bump tstyche from 6.2.0 to 7.1.0 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/pinojs/pino/pull/2429
* test: fix flaky transport config test by @mcollina in https://github.com/pinojs/pino/pull/2434
* chore: upgrade typescript to v6.0.2 by @Tony133 in https://github.com/pinojs/pino/pull/2419
* docs: fix typo "compatability" → "compatibility" in README by @premsreelathasugeendran in https://github.com/pinojs/pino/pull/2435
* docs: warn against untrusted top-level log keys by @mcollina in https://github.com/pinojs/pino/pull/2450
* test(transport): keep event loop alive while awaiting async flush by @YBJ0000 in https://github.com/pinojs/pino/pull/2470
* docs: clarify Node.js version support policy in LTS doc by @youdie006 in https://github.com/pinojs/pino/pull/2472
* fix: honor per-target level filter on single-element `targets` array by @mcollina in https://github.com/pinojs/pino/pull/2432
* fix(multistream): resolve string level labels in write() by @xianjianlf2 in https://github.com/pinojs/pino/pull/2474
* fix: escape child binding keys by @mcollina in https://github.com/pinojs/pino/pull/2452
* docs: clarify stringification limits by @mcollina in https://github.com/pinojs/pino/pull/2475
* fix: add setBindings to the browser logger by @ankit1324 in https://github.com/pinojs/pino/pull/2471
* build(deps): bump actions/setup-node from 6 to 7 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/pinojs/pino/pull/2486
* build(deps-dev): bump through2 from 4.0.2 to 5.0.10 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/pinojs/pino/pull/2488
* build(deps-dev): bump bole from 5.0.29 to 6.0.7 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/pinojs/pino/pull/2489
* build(deps-dev): bump eslint-plugin-n from 17.23.2 to 18.2.2 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/pinojs/pino/pull/2492
* build(deps): bump actions/checkout from 6.0.2 to 7.0.1 by @dependabot[bot] i
